_comment: Ground truth for retrieval quality. Milestone 2.
HOW THIS WAS LABELLED — this is the part that makes the metrics mean
something. Each `relevant_sources` list was written BY HAND by reading
eval/corpus_retrieval/*.md and deciding which document answers the
question. Nothing here was copied from what the RAG returned. Labelling
from RAG output would measure the retriever against itself and always
WHY FILENAMES, NOT CHUNK NUMBERS — `chunk_number` in the API response is
just the rank position (1..4) of that result, so it changes every query.
The stable identifier is `source`, the filename. Each corpus file is
under CHUNK_SIZE (800) and is one section, so one file == one chunk, and
naming the file names the chunk.
MULTI-ANSWER QUESTIONS are included on purpose (RET-09, RET-10). A
question whose answer spans two documents is where Precision@4 and Hit
Rate@4 stop agreeing, which is the point of measuring both.

questions.question: How many digits must the mobile number field accept?
questions.note: single document; the only file discussing digit count

questions.question: How long is the OTP valid before it expires?
questions.note: expiry stated only in the OTP document

questions.question: After how many failed attempts does the account lock?
What is the minimum password length?
Where does the Forgot Password link take the user?
How long until an idle session expires?
questions.note: session timeout stated only here; deliberately similar wording to RET-02 (expiry) to test discrimination

questions.question: Where on the page are field errors displayed?
How long are audit log entries retained?
questions.note: single document; 'retained' echoes 'retention' wording nowhere else

questions.question: What happens to the session token after a user logs out, and is that event recorded anywhere?
questions.note: two documents: token invalidation is in session handling, the recording question points at audit logging

questions.question: Which rules govern what a user types into the password and mobile fields?
What error message is shown for an invalid mobile number?
questions.note: the exact string lives in mobile validation, NOT in the error-messages document, which only describes placement and styling. A retriever that returns 07-error-messages.md has matched on the word 'error' rather than on meaning

questions.question: Who is allowed to read the audit log?
